# Evidence Note — Alder Site (child analyst: Alder)

Child scope: Alder only. Sources read: `sources/pilot-charter.txt` [S1] and
`sources/weekly-observations.txt` [S2]. `sources/reviewer-note.txt` [S3] was
deliberately not read by this child. All figures below are supported by verbatim
quoted lines; nothing is inferred or extrapolated.

## (a) Alder's 480-request site total

> ALDER: 4 site-weeks, 480 requests, 31 delayed acknowledgements, 2 supervisor escalations.

- Tag: [S2] — `sources/weekly-observations.txt`
- Measures: the total number of requests observed at the Alder site across its four
  pilot site-weeks, i.e. request volume processed at Alder during the pilot window.

## (b) Alder's 31 delayed acknowledgements

> ALDER: 4 site-weeks, 480 requests, 31 delayed acknowledgements, 2 supervisor escalations.

- Tag: [S2] — `sources/weekly-observations.txt`
- Measures: the count of Alder acknowledgements that exceeded the delay threshold
  during the four pilot site-weeks (a count of delayed acknowledgements, not a rate).

## (c) Acknowledgement median change from 18 minutes to 11 minutes

> BASELINE: 120 requests per site-week; manual acknowledgement median 18 minutes.

- Tag: [S1] — `sources/pilot-charter.txt`
- Measures: the pre-pilot baseline acknowledgement median — 18 minutes — for the
  manually handled acknowledgement process.

> PILOT: routed acknowledgement median 11 minutes; acknowledgement uses receipt timestamps.

- Tag: [S1] — `sources/pilot-charter.txt`
- Measures: the acknowledgement median measured under pilot routing — 11 minutes —
  stated against the 18-minute baseline above, i.e. a median change from 18 minutes
  to 11 minutes, with acknowledgement timing derived from receipt timestamps.

## (d) The weekday-only limit and the definition of a delay

> LIMIT: observations cover weekdays only; no weekend or Depot conclusion is supported.

- Tag: [S1] — `sources/pilot-charter.txt`
- Measures: the coverage boundary of the pilot observations — weekdays only — which is
  why no weekend or Depot conclusion is supported.

> DELAY: elapsed acknowledgement time greater than 15 minutes, measured after routing.

- Tag: [S2] — `sources/weekly-observations.txt`
- Measures: the operational definition of a "delay" used to count delayed
  acknowledgements: elapsed acknowledgement time strictly greater than 15 minutes,
  measured after routing.

## Bounding notes for the synthesising coordinator

- Conclusions drawn from these figures are bounded to the weekday pilot sites Alder,
  Brook and Cove; weekend behaviour and the Depot trial are outside the supported
  scope [S1].
- No wider rollout is evidenced by these two sources; the charter describes a
  four-week pilot window only [S1].
